title: Spotted Cats
content: Discovery News announced yesterday that the spotted patterns on woodland species of wild cats are tied to the patterns of dappled light in their forest environments.Cats in open ranges, such as lions, tend to have plain coloration. Tiger stripes, according to the University of Bristol researcher William Allen, are still something of a mystery.Full article by Jennifer ViegasPrevious GurneyJourney post on Dappled LightThanks, Libby!
